The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] used '''missile turrets''' as ground defenses. The turrets fired [[Homing missile/Legends|homing missiles]] against aerial targets from its two [[Missile launcher/Legends|launchers]]; it sat on a square base. In use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the turrets were deployed alongside [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. Starting from around [[0 ABY/Legends|6 months]] after the pivotal [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the turrets saw action against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. The launchers were deployed in the [[Liberation of Gerrard V|battle]] of [[Gerrard V]], to [[Battle of the Jade Moon|defend]] the [[Jade Moon]], to [[Raid on Balmorra|defend]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], to [[Assault on Kile II|defend]] the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Kile II]], to [[Rescue on Kessel|defend]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], were on platforms near [[Taloraan City]], protected a base on [[Fest/Legends|Fest]], [[Raid on Sullust|defended]] a capacitor on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and were [[Attack on Thyferra|deployed]] on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]].

==Behind the scenes==
Missile turrets appear in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']].
